inner_monologue_text: there! How is it going? Brazil has won the World Cup 5 times.
notes: Native full-duplex: a single autoregressive Moshi model models the user audio stream and its own audio stream in parallel and emits a time-aligned inner-monologue text stream. Turn-taking is decided inside the network at 12.5 Hz. No Silero/webrtcvad/energy gate and no turn-taking controller exist in hervoice/duplex/. 'first_model_audio_frame' = first frame the model's inner monologue emitted a real word, i.e. the frame the MODEL chose to start speaking. out_audio_rms in frame_trace.jsonl is descriptive logging only and gates nothing.
